text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- At least 100 Nigerian civilians and soldiers have been captured by Cameroon during fighting over the oil-rich Bakassi peninsula which began in 1994.

- A government plan to return accounts of parastatals and other agencies from the central bank to private banks will have a positive impact on the banking industry, says managing director of NAL Merchant Bank.
- Investors in Savannah Bank on Tuesday resolved its three-year crisis by electing a 10-member board of directors.
- Local contractors are pleading with the government for payment of 13.6 billion naira in debts, owed for jobs already completed.
- Difficulties with American visas may delay the arrival of finance minister Anthony Ani and the Nigerian government delegation at the annual conference of World Bank and International Monetary Fund.
